notes: Titles (was 'Headline') are now a full system: add as MANY titles as you need, each with its own font (any font from fonts/), size, colour, vertical position, outline, optional plate and its own show-from/show-to timing — all baked into the render. Because a title stays text, it's localizable: the LOC tab now has a 'Переклад тайтлів' grid (titles × languages) where you type each language's copy, and every language version renders with its own text. Fonts: you can now keep a family in its own folder (fonts/Poppins/Poppins-SemiBold.ttf) — subfolders are scanned too, and the font picker groups weights under the family name (Regular · Medium · SemiBold · Bold…) instead of a flat wall of filenames. Presets saved before a font was moved into a folder keep working. Animation: it's now clearly marked that only Typewriter survives the render — Pop and Rise are preview-only and show a warning when picked, so nobody ships expecting them. New: 'Text swaps' tablets in Smart captions — add your own transcript swaps (percent → %, workouts → wo) with ＋/✕, no JSON editing; they apply to both Whisper and Scribe. New: 'Time spent (all sessions)' in Settings — accumulated per-operation totals for today / 7 days / all time, with medians, the assembly cache hit rate and an estimate of the encoding time the cache avoided. New: the clip cache now prunes itself (entries unused for 30 days, and a 20 GB budget), so it can't grow forever; the manual Clear cache button stays. Earlier in this build: preview now matches the render exactly (single layout engine), assemble is ~8x faster (a finished body is normalized once and cached, then joined by stream copy), localizable text headlines, per-phrase styles, second word shadow, scrim fade, caption drag on the preview, Safe zones, transcript number/unit clean-up, the Assemble time board, and 'Hold last caption to end'.
